articles.title_en: Helping Children Catch Up: Early Life Shocks and the PROGRESA Experiment
articles.title_cn: 帮助儿童追赶：早期生活冲击与PROGRESA实验
articles.abstract_en: Children who face significant disadvantage early in life are often found to be worse off years or even decades later. Can conditional cash transfer programs mitigate the negative consequences and help these children catch up with their peers? We answer this question using data from rural Mexico, where rainfall shocks can have substantial effects on household income. We find that adverse rainfall in a child's year of birth decreases grade attainment, post-secondary enrolment and employment outcomes. But declines were much smaller for children whose families were randomised to receive the conditional cash transfer program, PROGRESA: each additional year of PROGRESA exposure during childhood mitigated almost 20% of the early disadvantage in grade attainment.
articles.abstract_cn: 在生命早期面临显著不利条件的儿童，往往在数年甚至数十年后仍处于劣势。有条件现金转移项目能否减轻这些负面后果，并帮助这些儿童赶上同龄人？我们利用墨西哥农村的数据来回答这个问题，在那里降雨冲击可能对家庭收入产生重大影响。我们发现，儿童出生年份的不利降雨会降低年级完成率、中学后入学率和就业结果。但对于那些家庭被随机分配接受有条件现金转移项目PROGRESA的儿童来说，这种下降要小得多：童年时期每多接触一年PROGRESA，就能缓解早期年级完成率劣势的近20%。

articles.title_en: Discontinuities in the Age-Victimisation Profile and the Determinants of Victimisation
articles.title_cn: 年龄-受害率曲线中的不连续性及受害的决定因素
articles.abstract_en: Dutch victimisation rates increase by 9%–15% immediately upon reaching ages 16 and 18. We disentangle the role of the many rights granted at these ages using offence location data, cross-cohort variation in the minimum legal drinking age driven by a 2014 reform and survey data of alcohol/drug consumption and mobility behaviours. We conclude that access to weak alcohol, bars/clubs and smoking increases victimisation at 16 and that age-18 rights (hard alcohol, marijuana coffee shops) exacerbate this risk; vehicle access does not play an important role. We find no evidence of systematic spillovers onto individuals still ineligible for these rights.
articles.abstract_cn: 荷兰的受害率在达到16岁和18岁时立即增加9%–15%。我们利用犯罪地点数据、由2014年改革驱动的法定最低饮酒年龄的跨队列变化以及酒精/毒品消费和出行行为的调查数据，来厘清在这些年龄被授予的众多权利的作用。我们得出结论，获得低度酒精、酒吧/俱乐部和吸烟的机会在16岁时增加了受害风险，而18岁时的权利（烈酒、大麻咖啡店）加剧了这一风险；车辆使用权并未发挥重要作用。我们没有发现系统性的溢出效应影响到那些尚不符合这些权利条件的个体。

articles.title_en: The Forward-Looking Effect of Increasing the Full Retirement Age
articles.title_cn: 提高全额退休年龄的前瞻性效应
articles.abstract_en: This paper analyses the effects of increasing the statutory retirement age for claiming full pension benefits on the labour force participation of middle-aged individuals and their partners. Identification relies on a difference-in-differences setting that exploits the heterogeneous increase in age eligibility for retirement caused by an unexpected pension reform. We detect a rise in the participation rate of middle-aged women that spills over into the labour supply of their husbands, who choose to postpone their retirement. The overall labour supply response has important implications for the extent of the fiscal externality associated with pension reforms that increase the retirement age.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文分析了提高领取全额养老金福利的法定退休年龄对中年人及其伴侣劳动力参与的影响。识别策略依赖于双重差分设定，利用一项意外的养老金改革导致的退休资格年龄的异质性提高。我们检测到中年女性参与率的上升，并溢出到其丈夫的劳动力供给中，他们选择推迟退休。总体劳动力供给反应对提高退休年龄的养老金改革相关的财政外部性程度具有重要含义。

articles.abstract_en: We examine how the evaluation of research studies in economics depends on whether a study yielded a null result. Studies with null results are perceived to be less publishable, of lower quality, less important and less precisely estimated than studies with large and statistically significant results, even when holding constant all other study features, including the sample size and the precision of the estimates. The null result penalty is of similar magnitude among PhD students and journal editors. The penalty is larger when experts predict a large effect and when statistical uncertainty is communicated with p-values rather than standard errors. Our findings highlight the value of a pre-result review.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了经济学研究评估如何取决于一项研究是否产生了零结果。与具有较大且统计显著结果的研究相比，零结果的研究被认为更不可发表、质量更低、重要性更小且估计精度更低，即使在其他所有研究特征（包括样本量和估计精度）保持不变的情况下也是如此。零结果惩罚在博士生和期刊编辑中的程度相似。当专家预测效应较大以及统计不确定性用p值而非标准误传达时，惩罚更大。我们的发现凸显了预结果审查的价值。

articles.title_en: Housing Prices and Credit Constraints in Competitive Search
articles.title_cn: 竞争性搜索中的房价与信贷约束
articles.abstract_en: Wealthier, risk-averse buyers pay more to speed up transactions in competitive search markets. This result is established in a dynamic housing model where households save to smooth consumption and build a down payment. ‘Block recursivity’ is ensured by the existence of risk-neutral housing intermediaries. In the long run, the calibrated benchmark features higher indebtedness and house prices than a Walrasian model, especially when housing supply elasticity is low. The long-run price effects of greater credit availability are much larger if rental and owner-occupied stocks are segmented, but even without segmentation they can be substantial when supply elasticity is low.
articles.abstract_cn: 在竞争性搜索市场中，更富有且风险规避的买家会支付更多以加快交易速度。这一结果在一个动态住房模型中得到确立，在该模型中，家庭储蓄以平滑消费并积累首付款。风险中性的住房中介的存在确保了‘块递归性’。长期来看，校准基准比瓦尔拉斯模型具有更高的负债率和房价，尤其是在住房供给弹性较低时。如果租赁和自有住房存量是分割的，信贷可得性增加的长期价格效应会大得多，但即使没有分割，当供给弹性较低时，这种效应也可能相当可观。

articles.title_en: Real Exchange Rates and the Earnings of Immigrants
articles.abstract_en: We relate origin-destination real price differences to immigrants’ reservation wages and their career trajectories, exploiting administrative data from Germany and the 2004 enlargement of the European Union. We find that immigrants who enter Germany when a unit of earnings from Germany allows for larger consumption at home settle for lower entry wages, but subsequently catch up to those arriving with less favourable exchange rates, through transition to better-paying occupations and firms. Similar patterns hold in the United States data. Our analysis offers one explanation for the widespread phenomenon of immigrants’ downgrading, with new implications for immigrant cohort effects and assimilation profiles.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用德国行政数据和2004年欧盟扩大，将来源地-目的地实际价格差异与移民的保留工资及其职业轨迹联系起来。我们发现，当德国收入单位在母国能带来更大消费时，进入德国的移民初始工资较低，但随后通过转向薪酬更高的职业和企业，追赶上了那些在汇率条件较差时到达的移民。美国数据中也存在类似模式。我们的分析为移民降级这一普遍现象提供了一种解释，并对移民群体效应和同化曲线产生了新的启示。

articles.title_en: Winter is Coming: Early-life Experiences and Politicians’ Decisions
articles.title_cn: 冬天来了：早年经历与政治家的决策
articles.abstract_en: This paper traces the formation of politicians’ policy preferences to their early-life experiences. Based on biographical information on 2,806 county party secretaries in China and fiscal data from the 1,713 counties they governed during the 1998–2007 period, we find that a one-percentage-point increase in the early-life famine severity experienced by a county party secretary increases fiscal expenditures on agriculture by 0.8% and on social security subsidies by 1.1%. Agricultural taxes are reduced significantly, boosting grain production in the county party secretaries’ work counties. Our findings suggest that county party secretaries who experience early-life famine may develop preferences for food sufficiency and care for people suffering hardships.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文追溯了政治家政策偏好的形成与其早年经历的关系。基于中国2,806位县委书记的个人信息及其治理的1,713个县在1998-2007年期间的财政数据，我们发现，县委书记早年经历的饥荒严重程度每增加一个百分点，其执政县的农业财政支出增加0.8%，社会保障补贴支出增加1.1%。农业税显著减少，从而促进了县委书记工作县的粮食生产。我们的研究结果表明，经历过早年饥荒的县委书记可能会形成对粮食自给自足的偏好，并关心遭受苦难的人们。

articles.title_en: The Welfare Effects of Greenbelt Policy: Evidence from England
articles.title_cn: 绿带政策的福利效应：来自英格兰的证据
articles.abstract_en: I measure the economic effects of greenbelts that prohibit new construction beyond a predefined urban fringe and therefore act as urban growth boundaries. I focus on England, where 13% of the land is designated as greenbelt land. I provide reduced-form evidence and estimate a quantitative equilibrium model that includes amenities, housing supply, a traffic congestion externality, agglomeration forces, productivity and household location choices. Greenbelt policy generates positive amenity effects, but also strongly reduces housing supply. I find that greenbelts increase welfare because amenity effects are sufficiently strong. At the same time, however, greenbelts decrease housing affordability by limiting housing supply.
articles.abstract_cn: 我衡量了绿带的经济效应，绿带禁止在预定城市边缘之外进行新建设，因此起到城市增长边界的作用。我聚焦于英格兰，那里13%的土地被划为绿带用地。我提供了简化形式证据，并估计了一个包含便利设施、住房供给、交通拥堵外部性、集聚力、生产率和家庭区位选择的定量均衡模型。绿带政策产生正向的便利设施效应，但也强烈减少了住房供给。我发现绿带提高了福利，因为便利设施效应足够强。然而，与此同时，绿带通过限制住房供给降低了住房可负担性。

articles.title_en: The Mortality Effects of Winter Heating Prices
articles.title_cn: 冬季供暖价格对死亡率的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines how the price of home heating affects mortality in the United States. Exposure to cold is one reason that mortality peaks in winter, and a higher heating price increases exposure to cold by reducing heating use. Our empirical approach combines spatial variation in the energy source used for home heating and temporal variation in the national prices of natural gas and electricity. We find that a lower heating price reduces winter mortality, driven mostly by cardiovascular and respiratory causes. Our estimates imply that the 42% drop in the natural gas price in the late 2000s, mostly driven by the shale gas boom, averted 12,500 deaths per year in the United States. The effect appears to be especially large in high-poverty communities.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了美国家庭供暖价格如何影响死亡率。暴露于寒冷是冬季死亡率达到峰值的原因之一，而较高的供暖价格会通过减少供暖使用来增加寒冷暴露。我们的实证方法结合了家庭供暖所用能源来源的空间差异以及天然气和电力全国价格的时间变化。我们发现，较低的供暖价格降低了冬季死亡率，主要由心血管和呼吸系统原因驱动。我们的估计表明，2000年代末天然气价格下降42%（主要由页岩气繁荣推动），在美国每年避免了12,500人死亡。这一效应在高度贫困社区尤为显著。

articles.title_en: Management Practices and Quality of Care: Evidence from the Private Health Care Sector in Tanzania
articles.title_cn: 管理实践与护理质量：来自坦桑尼亚私营医疗部门的证据
articles.abstract_en: We measure the adoption of management practices in over 220 private for-profit and non-profit health facilities in 64 districts across Tanzania and link these data to process quality-of-care metrics, assessed using undercover standardised patients and clinical observations. We find that better managed health facilities are more likely to provide correct treatment in accordance with national treatment guidelines, adhere to a checklist of essential questions and examinations, and comply with infection prevention and control practices. Moving from the 10th to the 90th percentile in the management practice score is associated with a 48% increase in correct treatment. We then leverage a large-scale field experiment of an internationally recognised management support intervention in which health facilities are assessed against comprehensive standards, given an individually tailored quality improvement plan and supported through training and mentoring visits. We find zero to small effects on management scores, suggesting that improving management practices in this setting may be challenging.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们衡量了坦桑尼亚64个县中超过220家私营营利性和非营利性医疗机构对管理实践的采纳情况，并将这些数据与通过秘密标准化患者和临床观察评估的过程性护理质量指标联系起来。我们发现，管理更好的医疗机构更有可能按照国家治疗指南提供正确治疗，遵守基本问题和检查清单，并遵守感染预防和控制实践。管理实践得分从第10百分位提高到第90百分位与正确治疗增加48%相关。然后，我们利用一项国际认可的管理支持干预的大规模实地实验，在该实验中，医疗机构根据综合标准进行评估，获得量身定制的质量改进计划，并通过培训和指导访问获得支持。我们发现对管理得分的影响为零到很小，这表明在这种环境下改善管理实践可能具有挑战性。
